answer_1.quote: We investigate how qualitative advantages of LLMs change when fine-tuning on parallel data... The LLM properties we investigate are general translation quality, formality steerability, non-literalness in idiom translations, performance on specialized domains, and performance on document-level input which requires contextualisation of ambiguous tokens.
answer_1.outputs: Translated sentences generated by fine‑tuned LLMs

answer_2.quote: We report COMET scores... We report COMET, LitTER and MWEScore, an internal multi-reference version of Score_mwe.
